spec.title: Build the Acme price sheet from the catalog file (i01, base)
spec.description: A code agent works in a workspace seeded with the plan catalog. It builds an Excel price sheet, one sheet per category with a yearly price, and in instances with a summary adds a Summary sheet in a second block. No other file in the workspace may change.

files.catalog.csv:
name,allowance,category,plan_id,monthly_usd
Acme Mobile 1,5 GB,mobile,mobile-1,94
Acme Mobile 2,20 GB,mobile,mobile-2,86
Acme Office 1,unlimited,office,office-1,74
Acme Office 2,250 GB,office,office-2,61
Acme Office 3,100 GB,office,office-3,27
Acme Travel 1,5 GB,travel,travel-1,5
Acme Mobile 3,40 GB,mobile,mobile-3,23
Acme Travel 2,1 GB,travel,travel-2,93
Acme Mobile 4,10 GB,mobile,mobile-4,28
Acme Office 4,100 GB,office,office-4,94
Acme Travel 3,5 GB,travel,travel-3,72
Acme Mobile 5,40 GB,mobile,mobile-5,19
Acme Travel 4,10 GB,travel,travel-4,83
Acme Mobile 6,40 GB,mobile,mobile-6,67
Acme Travel 5,1 GB,travel,travel-5,37
files.readme.txt: Sales operations folder of Acme Telecom. catalog.csv is the source of truth; nobody edits it by hand.

when.user: Build a price sheet from catalog.csv. Make one sheet per category, named Mobile, Office and Travel, with the columns Plan, Allowance, Monthly price (USD) and Yearly price (USD), and one row per line of the catalog, in catalog order. The yearly price is twelve times the monthly price. Save it as out/acme-prices.xlsx.
